name: ChatScene
summary: A clean, light LLM chat surface. User messages and assistant replies stream into a centered chat window — assistant turns show a typing indicator then stream word-by-word (or fade in a structured few-shot block). Continuous orb drift + window breathing keep the frame alive for deterministic headless capture.
bestFor: Showing how a prompt is sent to a model and how the model responds — few-shot / in-context learning demos, vague-vs-specific prompt comparisons, reasoning-model 'thinking then answering' beats.

kicker.description: Small uppercase eyebrow above the window.

modelName.description: Name shown in the chat title bar and composer.

turns.description: Ordered chat turns. Auto-distributed across the scene duration (override with per-turn `t` seconds).

text.description: Plain text. Assistant text streams in word-by-word.

html.description: Raw HTML body (e.g. few-shot example lines using in→out). Used instead of `text`; fades in as a block.

label.description: Optional uppercase label chip at the top of the bubble (e.g. 'Few-shot prompt').

t.description: Optional explicit start time (seconds from scene start) overriding auto-distribution.

props.title: Show the pattern — it continues it

turns.label: Few-shot prompt
turns.html: happy→positiveawful→negativebrilliant→?
